workstreams.name: Pricing by export market
workstreams.answers: How did realized prices and margins by export market change in 2025, and which markets drove the decline?
activities: Analyze sales and margin data by market, 2025 vs prior year
Split the margin change into price, mix and cost effects
Interview the people who set prices in each market

workstreams.name: Distributor terms
workstreams.answers: Which distributor terms differ across markets, and how much of the 2025 export margin decline do they explain?
activities: Review distributor contracts and agreed terms by market
Analyze order and payment data to compare terms in practice
Interview the people who manage distributor relationships
